narrative.details:
It's terrible, adventurer. We are not going to have enough parts to get our fleet of gyrodrillmatic excavationators to Dun Morogh.

What we need are spare parts, adventurer. What better place to get the spare parts for our vehicles than Gnomeregan? I hear that bots and mechs roam around that place like cattle on an open range.

What I need you to do is go to Gnomeregan and tear apart those robots. Bring me back their robot guts. Two dozen should be sufficient.
narrative.objectives: Bring twenty-four Robo-mechanical Guts to Shoni in Stormwind.
narrative.offerRewardText: This will do nicely, adventurer. One gyrodrillmatic excavationator fixed; 398 left to go.
narrative.requestItemsText: If this were a race, you would have lost by now.
